title: Accounts
content_data:
A TikTok account is a unified digital profile on the TikTok platform that enables individuals, creators, and brands to create multimedia content, engage with global communities, and conduct social commerce. You can see [Guides](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/accounts-api-guides/v1.3) to learn more about the authorization and authentication procedure, and rate limits for Accounts API. This group consists of the following endpoints: **Access token inspector** [Get the authorized TikTok Account permission scopes via access token](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1765927978092545) **Insights** > **Note**
> To view insights and analytics data, TikTok account owners need to first publish at least one video, then tap the "Turn On" button on the Analytics page of their mobile TikTok app. For more information, refer to [here](https://www.tiktok.com/feedback?id=7133058093574806018&lang=en&type=). - [Get profile data of a TikTok account](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1762228399168514) - [Get post data of a TikTok account](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1762228421622786) - [Get benchmarks for a business category](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1822388944791617) - [Get the post privacy settings of a TikTok account](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1816387951979521) **Comments** - [Get all comments on an owned video](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1760232109619202)
- [Get all replies to a comment](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1762228430145538)
- [Create a new comment on an owned video](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1762228442072066)
- [Upload a comment image](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1856212334897154)
- [Reply to an existing comment on an owned video](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1762228448779266)
- [Like/unlike an existing comment on an owned video](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1762228456608770)
- [Hide/unhide an existing comment on an owned video](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1762228474532865)
- [Delete an existing comment on an owned video](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1762228483080193) **Posts** - [Publish a public video post to an owned account](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1762228496095234) - [Publish a photo post to an owned account](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1803630424390658) - [Get the publishing status of a TikTok post](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1816387106635778) - [Get recommended hashtags for TikTok accounts](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1762228503821314) - [Get the location tags for a TikTok account](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-the-location-tags-for-a-tiktok-account/v1.3) **Ad authorization** - [Enable or disable the ad authorization setting for a TikTok post](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815051741912066) - [Extend the authorization validity period of a TikTok post](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815051784582210) - [Get the authorization status of a TikTok post](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815051801257986) - [Delete the authorization code of a TikTok post](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815051817073665) **URL properties** - [Add a URL property to an ad account](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1769325280876545) - [Check the URL property verification result](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1769325308162050) - [Delete the verified ownership of a URL property](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1769325351919617) - [Get the list of added URL properties under an ad account](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1769325368603650) **Webhooks** - [Create or update a TikTok account Webhook configuration](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1810521279479810) - [Get TikTok account Webhook configurations](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1810521289122818) - [Delete a TikTok account Webhook configuration](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1810521297052673)
